source.adaptation: Reviewed PPO actor/critic, trajectory buffer, checkpoint validation, and action scaling were moved into src/game_agent/rl and adapted to repository contracts.

method.name: independent_ppo_red_vs_frozen_blue
method.multi_agent_paradigm: single learned agent against frozen scripted opponent
method.why_learning: Delayed continuous interception creates state-dependent avoidance and timing trade-offs that a fixed geometric rule does not adapt across initial perturbations; MPC would require a trusted opponent dynamics model that the scenario does not provide.

method_hypothesis.statement: Online PPO with dense ring-distance progress shaping can learn a bounded red_0 controller that improves scenario success_rate against a frozen delayed interceptor without violating collision, boundary, or action constraints.
suspected_bottlenecks: Policy-gradient sensitivity to actor learning rate
Reward-scale balance between progress and safety
optimization_guidance: First tune actor learning rate and bounded distance-progress reward weight.
Keep scenario success_rate and hard constraints as promotion authority; never promote by training reward.
If stage 1 plateaus, adjust the PPO training recipe before changing policy-local architecture.

method_invariants: PPO remains the learned algorithm family.
Only red_0 is trained; blue_0 remains frozen.
Execution is decentralized and consumes only the acting agent local observation.
No explicit opponent-model state is added.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify the frozen scenario package.
Do not expose training-only global state at inference.
Do not change trained or frozen parties.
Do not rank or promote by training reward.
immutable_boundaries.information_limits: No global state or future opponent action is available to the learned policy.
immutable_boundaries.action_safety: Two learned normalized acceleration components are scaled into the first two scenario action dimensions; unused dimensions are zero and the final vector is clipped to scenario bounds.

checkpoint_binding.action_contract: learned box[2] in [-1,1], mapped to scenario box[4] with final clipping
